label: def:snake-identity
title: Snake identity
html:
Definition. Snake identity

Let (\mathbf{C}, \otimes, \mathbf{1}) be a monoidal category. Let V be an object with dual V^{\vee}, evaluation \mathrm{ev} \colon V \otimes V^{\vee} \to \mathbf{1}, and coevaluation \mathrm{coev} \colon \mathbf{1} \to V^{\vee} \otimes V. The snake identities are the equations making (\mathrm{ev}, \mathrm{coev}) exhibit V^{\vee} as a right dual of V:

\begin{equation}\label{eq:snake-identities}
\begin{gathered}
\begin{tikzcd}[row sep=2em, column sep=2.5em]
  V
    \ar[r, "\mathrm{id} \otimes \mathrm{coev}"]
    \ar[dr, "\mathrm{id}_V"']
  & V \otimes V^{\vee} \otimes V
    \ar[d, "\mathrm{ev} \otimes \mathrm{id}"]
  \\
  & V
\end{tikzcd}
\\[-0.5em]
\text{\small (left snake identity)}
\end{gathered}
\qquad\qquad
\begin{gathered}
\begin{tikzcd}[row sep=2em, column sep=2.5em]
  V^{\vee}
    \ar[r, "\mathrm{coev} \otimes \mathrm{id}"]
    \ar[dr, "\mathrm{id}_{V^{\vee}}"']
  & V^{\vee} \otimes V \otimes V^{\vee}
    \ar[d, "\mathrm{id} \otimes \mathrm{ev}"]
  \\
  & V^{\vee}
\end{tikzcd}
\\[-0.5em]
\text{\small (right snake identity)}
\end{gathered}
\end{equation}

The pair forms an exact pairing. In graphical calculus, the composites trace an S-shaped curve that straightens to a vertical line.
